errors.text_span: approximately 65% accuracy when the number of blanks is 1
errors.evidence: The data point for 1 blank is visibly higher than 65%. Given the y-axis scale where the space between 40 and 60 represents 20 percentage points, the first data point is closer to 68% or 70%.
The data point at 2 blanks is just slightly above the 20% grid line, indicating a value of approximately 22%. The value of 25% is a noticeable overestimation.
